defects_fixed.before: Operation filters were not consistently routed and the schema allowed behavior whose names implied side effects.
defects_fixed.after: A strict no-additional-properties schema exposes four read-only operations, routes optional synthetic identifiers, and preserves safe legacy aliases.

defects_fixed.before: The agent could imply eligibility, authorization, clinical interpretation, outreach, scheduling, or record mutation beyond evidence.
defects_fixed.after: Every route uses synthetic-only evidence, explicit uncertainty, no side effects, and a qualified human review gate.

claim_audit.claim: Verify insurance, referrals, and network status during patient intake
claim_audit.implementation: Coverage evidence is transcribed; live eligibility, referral, and network determinations remain in approved source systems.

claim_audit.claim: Deliver tailored digital packets with all required pre-visit forms
claim_audit.implementation: The agent produces a missing-item inventory but does not deliver packets or write records.

claim_audit.claim: Automate reminders across multiple scheduled touchpoints
claim_audit.implementation: No outbound communication or scheduling mutation is configured.

claim_audit.claim: Ensure clinicians’ availability and readiness through up-to-date scheduling data
claim_audit.implementation: Candidate synthetic source slots are displayed without booking or freshness claims.

claim_policy: Catalog value claims are qualitative. Exact fields and identifiers are retained only as clearly labeled synthetic evidence.
